intro.title: Build benchmark script for hot endpoints
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a Node.js script to benchmark the performance of 'hot' API endpoints—those frequently accessed in a web application. You'll learn how to simulate multiple concurrent requests to measure response times and throughput. The core programming concept is asynchronous execution using Promises and async/await to handle multiple HTTP calls efficiently. You'll use the built-in Node.js `http` or `https` modules to make requests and the `performance` timing APIs to collect metrics. By the end, you'll have a practical script that can help identify performance bottlenecks in real-world endpoints.
intro.usecase: Benchmarking hot endpoints is essential for performance monitoring in production applications. Developers use these scripts to identify slow API endpoints in e-commerce platforms during peak sales events, social media feeds during viral content spikes, and financial trading systems during market volatility. This helps teams proactively optimize critical paths before users experience slowdowns, ensuring reliability under load. Performance dashboards often display these benchmark results alongside real-time metrics to guide optimization decisions.
